allowed_actions: maintain versioned schemas and domain invariants
verification_requirements: Contracts trace to accepted requirements.
Serialization and invariants are tested.
Dependent lanes receive stable interfaces before implementation.
notes: Topological foundation slot. Readiness is set by the later Task Splitter after contract tasks exist.

verification_requirements: Core interactions satisfy assigned acceptance criteria.
No score, progression, or UI rules are embedded in physics nodes.
Debug tooling does not affect release behavior.
notes: Critical-path lane. It becomes ready after the minimum gameplay contracts and project skeleton are accepted.

role: World Objects and Level Runtime Builder
outputs: fixed level loading and generation tools
verification_requirements: Building transitions and fixed speed costs are deterministic.
Visual debris cannot alter gameplay.
Moving schedules repeat for the same level/ruleset version.
notes: Can overlap the physics lane after contact and event interfaces are stable.

role: Run Rules, Scoring, and Progression Builder
inputs: profile, save, progression, and run-record contracts
verification_requirements: Identical event sequences yield identical results.
Offline progression and save recovery are proven.
Stock and Progression eligibility rules are tested.
notes: Starts after core event contracts; full integration waits for the playable gameplay loop.

allowed_actions: implement owned UI and input files
integrate approved audio and VFX hooks
verification_requirements: Keyboard and gamepad parity is demonstrated.
Accessibility constraints are tested.
UI contains no duplicated gameplay-domain logic.
notes: Input skeleton and debug HUD can start early; most screens depend on stable run/profile presentation models.

role: Online Services and Release Infrastructure Builder
inputs: API, run-record, identity, progression-ledger, and crash-report contracts
allowed_actions: implement owned backend and release files
verification_requirements: Invalid and replayed records are rejected with reason codes.
Service outages do not block local gameplay.
Release builds exclude development-only tools.
notes: Contract work can begin early; substantial backend implementation should follow stable scoring and run-record semantics.

verification_requirements: Findings are reproducible and contract-linked.
Critical-path integrations are covered.
The MVP boundary remains intact.
notes: Cross-cutting role, not a mandatory full-time implementation lane. Activate where integration risk justifies it.

allowed_actions: inspect any selected task across lanes
write explicit red-team tests when assigned
verification_requirements: Findings are concrete and traceable.
No unilateral product or implementation changes are made.
Review scope matches the assigned risk.
notes: Floating adversarial reviewer; not counted as a normal implementation lane or required on trivial tasks.
